build_nose_hoover_nvt_thermostat: build a NoseHooverNVT thermostat with target temperature and damping time for NVT MD simulation
build_bussi_thermostat: build a Bussi stochastic velocity rescaling thermostat with target temperature and coupling time
build_langevin_thermostat: build a Langevin thermostat with target temperature and friction coefficient for stochastic MD
build_berendsen_npt_thermostat: build a Berendsen NPT thermostat with temperature, pressure, and compressibility for constant pressure MD
save_restore_thermostat_state: save and restore thermostat state for checkpointing and resuming molecular dynamics simulations
